text: BAM share rose 0.15 percentage points over 24 hours and 0.27 percentage points over 7 days, to 32.8% of Solana stake. Leadership is currently ams-mainnet-bam-dev at 23.8%, with the node Nakamoto coefficient at 3, so concentration remains elevated. The latest top-node change was whale-driven routing, not a structural rollover; only the fra rollover on 2026-06-24 has been validated, with 22 minutes of warning.
